name: Caramel Sauce
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: half a glass of brandy or a glass of wine
ingredients.originalText: half a glass of brandy or a glass of wine
ingredients.quantityText: half a glass of brandy or a glass of wine

instructions.text: Place over the fire a saucepan
When it begins to be hot, put into it four tablespoonfuls of white sugar and one tablespoonful of water
Stir it continually for three or four minutes, until all the water evaporates
Watch it carefully until it becomes a delicate brown color
Have ready a pint of cold water and cup of sugar mixed with some flavoring
Turn it into the saucepan with the browned sugar and let it simmer for ten minutes
Add half a glass of brandy or a glass of wine

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Place over the fire a saucepan
2. When it begins to be hot, put into it four tablespoonfuls of white sugar and one tablespoonful of water
3. Stir it continually for three or four minutes, until all the water evaporates
4. Watch it carefully until it becomes a delicate brown color
5. Have ready a pint of cold water and cup of sugar mixed with some flavoring
6. Turn it into the saucepan with the browned sugar and let it simmer for ten minutes
7. Add half a glass of brandy or a glass of wine
